titles.title: Healing at the Academy Convenience Store

description:
Me. Lee Young-jin. Twenty-nine years old. Orphan. Master Convenience Store Worker. 

I came up to Seoul with a mere five million won, earned recognition for my business acumen at a convenience store in Seongbuk-dong, and on the very night my promotion to store owner was finally decided, I was hit by a damn delivery truck and met my demise… but instead, I possess the body of the villainous prince in the shitty game I’ve always been obsessed with. 

Me. Wolfram von Lohengrin. Prince. Expelled student council president. The villain with the neck-cut in the intro… but I refuse to die again immediately after dying! 

Love and adventure are the protagonists' lot anyway. From now on, my dream is to be the owner of a convenience store in another world. Unleashing the amazing skills of a Master Convenience Store Worker and a hardcore gamer, I will empty the pockets of everyone in the academy!
